denominator.revision_policy: latest append row within the exact consumed JSONL prefix; identity invariants must remain stable and all revision counts are reported

causal_policy_state_fallback.contract: Uses only the preregistered t30 policy action and its 30-second PIT horizon. It cannot use t120 state, terminal value, public touch, or future fill.

same_stage_baseline.shares_contract: maker and taker must have identical target shares at the same t30 book epoch
same_stage_baseline.missing_policy: retain row, zero credit, block readiness

v2_1_router.fair_value_clock: freeze the PIT t0 weather-model probability through the t30 execution decision
v2_1_router.missing_transition_hazard_policy: block maker only; keep a same-clock taker or skip eligible
v2_1_router.missing_fill_probability_policy: candidate may enter explicitly authorized measurement, but maker cannot be selected as the profit route

maker_fill_contract: Only authoritative own-order lifecycle/fill evidence is a maker fill. Quote, touch, cross, displayed depth, and queue simulation are not fills.

mere.name: maker_execution_residual_edge
mere.unit: USD per share on the same signal row

inference.pass: lower confidence bound exceeds frozen MERE and correctness, tail, and capacity gates pass
inference.futility: upper confidence bound is below frozen MERE

incentive_contract.credit_rule: Only realized ledger entries with immutable payout and eligibility identity plus verified asset are credited; estimates receive zero credit.

staged_gate_contract.zero_notional_readiness: safe deterministic state plus same-stage maker/taker/skip comparison; no actual fill requirement
staged_gate_contract.micro_live_measurement: separate explicit funds authorization plus venue, fee, own-order, risk, cancel-all and release truth; no prior fill requirement
staged_gate_contract.frozen_forward_profitability: actual fill/nonfill denominator, realized incentives, tail/capacity evidence and target-date confidence interval above MERE

historical_negative_prior.scope: existing weather broad-maker review; prior only, not a V2.1 outcome
historical_negative_prior.conclusion: broad maker remains rejected_for_now; V2.1 is a narrow, causal maker overlay on frozen weather alpha
